description: Superficie Afectada por Incendios Forestales, 1972-2024 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Oficina Nacional de Estadística (ONE). Este conjunto de datos contiene la Superficie Afectada por Incendio Forestales de la Oficina Nacional de Estadísticas (ONE), generada en el periodo 1972-2024, en el cual se puede encontrar la cantidad de hectáreas afectada por incendios forestales para los años. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Oficina Nacional de Estadística (ONE). Its tags are Estadísticas, Medio Ambiente y Sociedad. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
